items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: I, I never asked him how he and Lou got together and all that.

ctx.x: Well, in, in that he's the one that got Fats recorded with, uh, uh, uh, Imperial. Mm-hmm. You know, uh, Al had, was working for Apollo and, uh, another couple of labels down here, down here. Selling the records and, and looking for talent and doing things with them. And how, I, I don't know. I, I never asked him how he and Lou got together and all that. But, but Al was in at the very beginning on the Fats Domino stuff. And then he got shut out. Somewhere along the way.
He, he, he brought Fats to Lou? He, he.
